BRUSSELS (Meridian Brief) — Varnholt Logistics has appointed Ilse Marrenkamp as its new chief executive, people familiar with the matter said.

The appointment took effect on 14 March, following a board vote the previous evening. Tobias Wennerlund, chair of the Varnholt Logistics board, announced the decision and described Marrenkamp as "the unanimous choice."

Marrenkamp takes over a company with 6,200 employees and annual revenue of €1.8 billion.

The reports rest on the company's formal press release, "Board Announces Leadership Succession," issued on 14 March and filed with the regional business registry.

Those familiar with the matter said the transition is under way and that Marrenkamp assumed her duties immediately upon the announcement.

Varnholt Logistics did not immediately provide further comment beyond the filed release.
